messages:
Maya: dropped a new compact 'signature pill' variant that stacks name + latency and shows a tiny example badge. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-stack-v1 :eyes:
Owen: looks neat. main asks: keyboard entrypoint, clear SR summary, and no hover-only controls.
Priya: SR suggestion: announce as 'Tool call, <name>, collapsed, N fields, has examples' on focus. short and scannable.
Maya: micro-copy question: 'translate_doc \u00b7 94ms' or 'translate_doc — 94ms'? leaning middle dot for density.
Owen: middle dot for density. also protect against very long tool names by ellipsizing to ~30 chars, tooltip for hover, and announce full name to screen readers on focus.
Priya: keyboard pattern: Tab lands on list container, Arrow keys move between items; Enter expands a card and moves focus to first field; Esc collapses and returns focus to the card. consistent with other lists.
Maya: accessibility nit: the expand control should be labelled 'View full output' (more user-friendly) and have aria-expanded toggled. also include aria-controls pointing at the inline panel.
Owen: Copy signature debate: show clipboard icon in a trailing overflow menu vs inline secondary action. If overflow, ensure the menu is keyboard-focusable with a clear 'More actions' label.
Priya: prefer inline secondary but visually hidden until focus to reduce click targets. Must still be reachable by keyboard. use .sr-only focusable element that becomes visible on keyboard focus.
Maya: added a tiny inline JSON preview in mock: ```json
{"name":"translate_doc","params":{"text":"Ciao mondo","target_lang":"en"}}
```
Owen: layout thought: line1 signature pill + :page_facing_up: badge if examples; line2 = truncated first field; meta row = type | tokens | latency. ensure header text contrast meets 4.5:1.
Priya: row height tension: ops want 44px, design 56px. propose 48px for testing and run keyboard focus tests at that density.
Maya: focus ring: 3px, high-contrast color, visible against dark/light themes. also test with Windows high-contrast mode.
Owen: SR phrasing for field reads: keep it terse: 'text, string, Ciao mondo' — don't read long content unless user requests 'read full'.
Priya: final microcopy call: expand action = 'View full output', secondary = 'Copy signature'. keep consistent across Playground and Run History.
design-bot: Uploaded Figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-stack-v1 (v1) — comments left on keyboard pattern.
Maya: thanks! I'll iterate on the keyboard pattern and drop updated images tomorrow. :party-parrot:
